ayahs.1: Woh tursh-ru hua aur munh mod liya.
ayahs.2: (Sirf is liye) ke us ke paas ek naabina aaya.
ayahs.3: Tujhe kya khabar, shaayad woh sanwar jaata.
ayahs.4: Ya naseehat sunta aur use naseehat faayda pahunchaati.
ayahs.6: Us ki taraf to tu poori tawajjoh karta hai.
ayahs.7: Halaanke us ke na sanwarne se tujh par koi ilzaam nahin.
ayahs.8: Aur jo shakhs tere paas daudta hua aata hai.
ayahs.10: To us se be-rukhi baratta hai.
ayahs.11: Yeh theek nahin, Quran to naseehat (ki cheez) hai.
ayahs.12: Jo chaahe is se naseehat le.
ayahs.15: Aise likhne walon ke haathon mein hai.
ayahs.17: Allah ki maar, insaan par kaisa na-shukra hai.
ayahs.18: Use Allah ne kis cheez se paida kiya.
ayahs.19: Use ek nutfe se paida kiya, phir us ka andaaza muqarrar kiya.
ayahs.20: Phir us ke liye raasta aasan kiya.
ayahs.21: Phir use maut di aur phir qabr mein dafn kiya.
ayahs.22: Phir jab chaahega use zinda kar dega.
ayahs.23: Hargiz nahin. Us ne ab tak Allah ke hukm ki baja-aawari nahin ki.
ayahs.24: Insaan ko chaahiye ke apne khaane ko dekhe.
ayahs.25: Ke hum ne khoob paani barsaya.
ayahs.26: Phir phaada zameen ko achhi tarah.
ayahs.27: Phir is mein se anaaj ugaaye.
ayahs.32: Tumhare istemaal-o-faayde ke liye aur tumhare chaupaayon ke liye.
ayahs.33: Pas jab ke kaan behre kar dene wali (qayamat) aa jaayegi.
ayahs.34: Us din aadmi apne bhai se.
ayahs.35: Aur apni maa aur apne baap se.
ayahs.36: Aur apni biwi aur apni aulaad se bhaagega.
ayahs.37: In mein se har ek ko us din aisi fikr (daaman-geer) hogi jo us ke liye kaafi hogi.
ayahs.38: Us din bahut se chehre roshan honge.
ayahs.40: Aur bahut se chehre us din ghubaar-aalood honge.
ayahs.41: Jin par siyaahi chadhi hui hogi.
ayahs.42: Woh yehi kaafir bad-kirdaar log honge.
